findings.title: Delete-cache mutation does not invalidate connected calendars query
findings.body: The deleteCache mutation's onSuccess only calls the optional onSuccess callback. It does not invalidate `viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars`, unlike the disconnect mutation. In SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper, `onChanged` may be undefined, so after deleting cache the UI can continue to display the old `cacheUpdatedAt` until a manual refetch. Invalidate the connectedCalendars query after deletion.

findings.title: Cache timestamp ignores user locale
findings.body: The cache timestamp is formatted with `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US")`, hardcoding English formatting even though the component uses `useLocale`. Non-English users will see an en-US date/time format. Use the active locale or a localized date formatter.

findings.title: Empty actions container rendered when CredentialActionsDropdown returns null
findings.body: The wrapper always wraps CredentialActionsDropdown in `<div className="flex w-32 justify-end">`. When the dropdown returns null (for example, a delegation credential with no cache or connection modification disabled), the empty div still occupies layout space in AppListCard/Alert actions. Render the container only when actions are present or move it inside the dropdown component.

findings.title: Disabled scope is not propagated to credential actions
findings.body: The wrapper computes `shouldDisableConnectionModification = isDisabled || disableConnectionModification`, but passes only `disableConnectionModification` to ConnectedCalendarList. When the current scope is disabled, CredentialActionsDropdown can still show and execute disconnect/delete-cache actions. Pass `shouldDisableConnectionModification` if the disabled scope is meant to prevent modifications.

findings.title: Cache status query includes expired CalendarCache rows
findings.body: `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` groups all CalendarCache rows for the credential without filtering `expiresAt`. Since `getCachedAvailability` only uses rows where `expiresAt >= now`, expired rows can still make the UI show a cache status and delete action. Add an `expiresAt: { gte: new Date() }` filter if the status should represent active cache.

findings.title: Delete-cache authorization does not account for delegation credentials shown in UI
findings.body: The UI shows delete-cache for Google calendars with a cache timestamp even when `delegationCredentialId` is present, but the handler only allows credentials where `userId` equals the session user. If the underlying credential is a delegation/team credential not owned by the user, the mutation fails despite the UI offering the action. Handle delegation credentials or align UI visibility with authorization.

findings.title: Cache refresh updates all SelectedCalendar rows for the credential
findings.body: `fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache` calls `updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {})`, which touches every selected calendar under the credential, including event-type-level rows not part of the calendars just cached. If the only purpose is to bump `updatedAt`, this creates unnecessary writes/timestamp churn; scope the update to affected calendars or remove it if unused.

findings.title: UserWithCalendars type now requires additional selected-calendar fields
findings.body: Adding `updatedAt` and `googleChannelId` to `allSelectedCalendars` and `userLevelSelectedCalendars` changes the shape of a type exposed through the legacy `getConnectedDestinationCalendars` export. External or platform consumers constructing this object with only the previous fields will break. If intentional, document it; otherwise consider making the new fields optional or updating consumers.

findings.title: dev:cron uses npx tsx without a pinned/installed dependency
findings.body: The script was changed to `npx tsx cron-tester.ts`, but `tsx` is not in dependencies/devDependencies. This makes the dev script depend on npx downloading an unpinned package at runtime, which can fail offline and is nondeterministic. Add `tsx` as a devDependency or pin the version.

findings.title: Webhook test script uses CWD-relative env path and macOS-only sed
findings.body: `ENV_FILE="../.env"` is resolved from the current working directory, so running `scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh` from the repo root writes to the parent directory rather than the repo env file. The script also uses `sed -i ''`, which is BSD/macOS syntax and fails on GNU/Linux. Resolve the env file relative to the script/repo root and use portable sed invocation.

findings.title: No automated tests for deleteCache authorization and deletion
findings.body: The new deleteCache handler contains authorization logic and deletes CalendarCache rows, but the PR adds no tests covering unauthorized credential IDs, non-existent credentials, or successful deletion. Add handler/repository tests to prevent regressions in access control and cache deletion.
